01 Objective

Folio is a fictional independent publishing studio. This guide brings its visual identity into one working reference: typography, colour, marks, photography and the grid that holds them together.

Brand summary

02 Contents

Use these pages when preparing an edition, presenting a project or briefing a creative partner. Keep the system consistent while allowing individual stories to retain their own character.

03 Designer

Folio Studio creates thoughtful editorial identities for cultural projects, independent publications and people with a clear point of view.

Colors

Forest Green

Forest green anchors the identity. Use the solid colour for strong fields and the lighter steps for quiet supporting structure. Keep enough contrast between text and its background at every level.

Logo

Logo design

The Folio mark is a simple signature. Its value comes from consistent use alongside thoughtful work. Give it clear space and choose the version that remains legible on the intended background.

Folio Studio

NOV 2026

Logo

Design process

Choose the mark for the background, then leave it room to breathe. Keep its proportions intact and avoid adding decorative effects.


Color palette

The palette works as a system. Pair a strong field with a quiet supporting tone, and use pink to bring emphasis to a specific moment.

Logo basics

A clear mark should remain recognisable at a small size. Use the supplied variations, preserve their proportions and keep unrelated elements outside the surrounding clear space.

14

Photos

Clarity

Build each image around a clear subject. Let a gesture, object or relationship lead the frame, and remove distractions that do not support the story.



Naturalism

Photograph people with patience. Choose natural gestures and believable situations, and crop with care so that the image remains open and respectful.

FOLIO / IDENTITY

15

Photos

Perfect lighting

Look for soft, directional light that describes the subject without overwhelming it. Keep highlights controlled and preserve the atmosphere of the place.
